pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-polygonal dark regions with relatively smooth, slightly rounded vertices. Edge gradients are soft due to resolution constraints, but maintain distinct geometric boundaries across the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light interstitial spaces forming clear tri-point and quadri-point junctions. Corridor width is relatively uniform but shows slight thickening at nodal intersections on the upper-mid flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short-cropped, dense mane showing a consistent low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge against the background along the cervical and thoracic ridge.
